subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("charm pricing" OR "left-digit effect" OR ".99 pricing" OR "odd pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR pricing OR ecommerce OR "direct-to-consumer")
queries.rationale: Captures experimental evidence on whether prices ending in .99 or .95 still increase sales and under what conditions.

queries.query: ("scarcity cue" OR "limited quantity" OR "limited time" OR "only X left") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail" OR "purchase decision")
queries.rationale: Finds field experiments and lab studies testing how scarcity messages impact conversion, cart abandonment, and perceived value.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "review valence" OR "review helpfulness" OR "star rating") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "online retail" OR "conversion rate")
queries.rationale: Targets quantitative studies on how review volume, average rating, and review content influence product sales and trust.

queries.query: ("discount depth" OR "promotion frequency" OR "deal proneness" OR "price promotion") AND (brand OR "perceived quality" OR "brand equity" OR loyalty)
queries.rationale: Seeks research on when discounts erode brand premium or quality perceptions versus when they boost acquisition.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "advertisement effectiveness" OR "visual appeal" OR "emotional appeal") AND (conversion OR "click-through rate" OR "purchase intent" OR A/B)
queries.rationale: Finds A/B tests and experimental studies isolating which elements of ad creative (imagery, text, CTAs) drive measurable performance.

queries.query: ("landing page" OR "website design" OR "checkout flow" OR "conversion funnel") AND (optimization OR A/B OR experiment OR "user experience")
queries.rationale: Captures controlled tests on layout, copy, form fields, and friction points that directly impact conversion rates.

queries.query: ("product naming" OR "brand name" OR "product description") AND (marketing OR consumer OR "purchase likelihood" OR memorability)
queries.rationale: Targets evidence on how name characteristics (length, sound, meaning) and descriptive language affect consumer choice.

queries.query: ("default option" OR "choice architecture" OR nudging) AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR "subscription" OR checkout)
queries.rationale: Finds field experiments on how pre-selected options (e.g., subscription renewals, add-ons) influence final decisions and revenue.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "shipping threshold" OR "minimum purchase") AND (conversion OR "average order value" OR "cart abandonment" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Seeks quantitative studies on the impact of free shipping offers and minimum purchase requirements on basket size and conversion.

queries.query: ("personalization" OR "recommendation system" OR "targeted message") AND (ecommerce OR "direct-to-consumer" OR "email marketing" OR "retargeting")
queries.rationale: Captures A/B tests and field experiments measuring the lift from personalized product recommendations, emails, or ads.

queries.query: ("price framing" OR "partitioned pricing" OR "drip pricing") AND (consumer OR "perceived cost" OR "transaction utility" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Targets studies on how breaking down prices (product + shipping + tax) versus bundling affects perceived value and purchase.

queries.query: ("visual attention" OR "eye tracking") AND (marketing OR "website design" OR "product page" OR "ad design")
queries.rationale: Finds eye-tracking and biometric studies showing what consumers actually look at on product pages, ads, and landing pages.

queries.query: ("customer retention" OR "churn prediction" OR "loyalty program") AND (ecommerce OR "subscription business" OR "direct-to-consumer" OR DTC)
queries.rationale: Seeks evidence-based models and interventions for predicting and reducing customer churn in subscription and repeat-purchase contexts.

queries.query: ("message framing" OR "gain-loss framing" OR "attribute framing") AND (marketing OR advertising OR "consumer persuasion" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Captures experiments testing whether emphasizing benefits (gain) or avoiding losses (loss) is more effective in ads and promotional copy.

queries.query: ("influencer marketing" OR "sponsored content" OR "creator marketing") AND (effectiveness OR "purchase intent" OR ROI OR "brand lift")
queries.rationale: Targets empirical studies measuring the sales impact, credibility, and ROI of influencer partnerships versus traditional ads.

coverage_notes: Plan focuses on 15 high-precision queries targeting the reader's practical, conversion-driven interests in pricing, promotions, messaging, and digital experience optimization. Uses Pattern A (specific phenomenon × marketing/consumer anchor) throughout, as marketing science is a broad field with many named effects. Angles covered include pricing psychology, scarcity, social proof, discounts/brand, ad creative, landing pages, naming, choice architecture, shipping, personalization, price framing, visual attention, retention, message framing, and influencer marketing. Deliberately skipped academic theory, advertising history, media studies, and brand-relationship frameworks, per the profile's preference for 'what actually works' with numbers.
